title: fix(driver-turso,driver-sql): refusals and log lines state each decision in words instead of a tracker number (stage 4)
body:
Part of #20513
Clause-②: no

**Stage 4 of 5 of this lane (`driver-turso`), under the maintainer's A / A ruling on the card, plus the three `driver-sql` aggregate refusals stage 1 held for their Turso twins.** The card stays open for stage 5, so this PR carries no closing keyword. Text only: no error `code`, field name, HTTP status, export or control flow moves. Every changed source line sits inside a string literal: a TypeScript-scanner skeleton of each of the four source files (every literal replaced by one placeholder, pure-literal `+` joins collapsed, comments dropped) is identical at the merge base and at the head, and the same check reports DIFF on a file with a real code change (control).

## What this does

The Turso driver's refusals and log lines sent the reader to a tracker number for the reason behind them. Most of the remote transport's numbers were bare ids from the repository that file used to live in (`remote-transport.ts` was moved here from the cloud repository), so in this repository they resolve to unrelated cards: a Vercel deploy fix, a CLI command, a version-packages PR. Each rewritten string now says the reason in words (form D, as the migration-entry rewrite and stages 1 to 3 applied it). Where the sentence already stated what was decided, only the citation goes. Where it did not, the decision is added in words:

| Where | Cited | The sentence now says |
|---|---|---|
| `remote-transport.ts` non-boolean `$null` diagnostic | objectstack 5347, objectstack 5368, cloud 1116 | Every driver now refuses it, so one filter no longer gets a different answer per backend. |
| `turso-driver.ts` remote `auto_number` refusal (thrown, 501) | 6944 | It is refused rather than resolved, because resolving would write NULL into the slot and persist the row without its record number. This replaces "Until this change the same call RESOLVED and wrote NULL", which described history rather than today. |
| `remote-canonical-backfill.ts` info line | 5770 | The converted rows now hold the one canonical text form, and the column drops the unindexable read-side repair only once a pass finds nothing left to convert. |
| `remote-canonical-backfill.ts` unresolvable-remainder warning | cloud 1005 (with a Chinese tag) | A value that cannot be read as an instant is counted and reported, never guessed at. |
| everything else: the five aggregate refusals, the withheld cross-field and unbindable-comparand wire sentences, the full diagnostics of the unsupported-operator, unlowered-`$between`, undeclared and non-list combinator, non-node operand, non-object `where`, empty operator map, undefined comparand, unbindable comparand and non-boolean `$exists` refusals, and the unnumbered-upsert warning | 5907, 10413, 6409, 6212, 5347, 5369, 5903, 5769, 5348, 6050, 7929, 8197, 7099, cloud 1003, 1004, 1051, 1058, 1066, 1073, 1075, 1076 | The sentence already said what was decided; only the citation goes. |

Each new sentence was checked against today's code, not only against the cited card: a non-boolean `$null` is refused by all five drivers (`driver-sql`'s `nonBooleanNullComparandError`, inherited by `driver-sqlite-wasm` and Turso local; `driver-memory`'s `filter-refusal.ts` door and query path; `driver-mongodb`'s `mongodb-filter.ts`; this transport); `refuseUngeneratableRemoteAutonumber` runs on `create`, `bulkCreate` and a match-key-less `upsert`, and `RemoteTransport.create` builds its own INSERT without `fillAutoNumberFields`; the backfill marks a column canonical only when its post-pass probe finds nothing left to change, and leaves out-of-band digit rows alone, counted into `unresolvedEpochTextRows`.

## The three held pairs, moved together

Stage 1 held three `driver-sql` aggregate refusals (undeclared function, `count_distinct` without `field`, per-aggregation `filter`) because `driver-turso` compares them byte for byte with the remote transport's copies. Both faces drop the citation in one commit (`fe71ac88e`), and the pins stay byte-exact: `remote-transport-aggregate-function-refusal.test.ts` (the undeclared `median` / `array_agg` / `string_agg` and miscased cases, the field-less `count_distinct` case, the per-aggregation filter case) and `remote-transport-undeclared-aggregate-keys.test.ts` (the `func:` spelling) compare the two runtime messages. The same commit drops the remote declared-but-uncompiled and date-bucket citations, whose `driver-sql` copies stage 1 already cleared, so those pairs read identically again.

One-off ablation on the committed head, run under a shell trap: the three old citations planted back on the `driver-sql` face only (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor hit once, disk-verified), `driver-sql` rebuilt, each marker confirmed in `dist/` (`scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`). The two `driver-turso` files then gave **10 failed, 23 passed**: every pair has a live pin. After the restore (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), the rebuild, and all three markers confirmed absent from `dist/`, they gave 33/33. `git status --porcelain` was empty afterwards.

`remote-transport-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` derives the remote `$between` arity sentence from `driver-sql`'s by stripping a parenthesised id. Neither side carries one any more, so that strip is now an identity; no sentence in this stage is derived that way.

## Order inside the stage

32 literals (47 occurrences) fit one PR, under the stop line, so the stage lands whole in four ordered commits. Each of the first three recomputes the ledger, so every commit is green on `check:doc-authoring`:

1. `fe71ac88e` author-visible: the aggregate refusal family, 8 literals on both faces;
2. `ab16ca922` author-visible: the remote filter refusals and the `auto_number` refusal, 21 literals (36 occurrences), plus the two re-pinned tests;
3. `8c7541655` log lines: 3 literals;
4. `252a378f9` the changeset.

`driver-turso` has no ledgered `src/`-shipped test string (its two testkits carry no id).

## Pins re-pinned: 2 tests in 2 test files (4 id assertions become 3 sentence assertions)

- `remote-transport-null-comparand-refusal.test.ts`: "cites the ruling and the framework landing so both repos are findable" asserted three ids. It now states the ruling in words and asserts "It is refused rather than coerced" and "Every driver now refuses it, so one filter no longer gets a different answer per backend."
- `remote-transport-comparand-refusal.test.ts` 234 matched two ids. It now asserts `indistinguishable from "no rows matched".`

A one-off mutation proves each moved pin can fail, run on the committed head with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode under a shell trap. The tests import the transport from `src`, so no build leg applies. "Every driver now" to "Every backend now": 1 failed / 54 passed. Appending "here" after "no rows matched": 1 failed / 26 passed. After each leg the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty; both files then gave 82/82, and `git status --porcelain` had 0 lines.

No test outside `driver-turso` pins a changed string. Every fragment of every changed sentence was searched in all test files of the repository: the hits are unrelated uses of common phrases, and `rest`'s `rest-4xx-message-truncation.test.ts`, whose own copy of a `$null` sentence is never compared with a driver's (see Acceptance notes).

## Ledger burn-down

`scripts/doc-authoring-prose-id.baseline.json` was regenerated with `node scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs --census-ledger` into a scratch file, so the growth refusal ran against the checked-in baseline, and then copied into place. Only these four rows move, and every one leaves:

| File | Occurrences before | after | (file, id) pairs before | after |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts` | 40 | 0 (row leaves) | 22 | 0 |
| `driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts` | 2 | 0 (row leaves) | 2 | 0 |
| `driver-turso/src/remote-canonical-backfill.ts` | 2 | 0 (row leaves) | 2 | 0 |
| `driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (the three held) | 3 | 0 (row leaves) | 3 | 0 |
| **whole ledger** | **769** | **722** | **514** | **485** |

The ledger's file count goes from 204 to 200; the gate's printed pinned sites (id-bearing literals) go from 647 to 615. A census of every other package's (file, id) occurrences before and after is identical (722 = 722).

**The census count, reconciled.** The census counted 24 messages for `driver-turso`; the ledger holds 44 occurrences. The gate counts 29 string literals. The census folds a `+` chain into one message, and five two-literal chains (the `$exists` diagnostic, the undeclared-combinator tail, the `$and` / `$or` requirement, and the cross-field and unbindable wire sentences) make 29 literals into 24 messages. Those 29 literals carry 44 occurrences, the census's own "id occurrences 44". With `driver-sql`'s 3 held literals, this stage moves 32 literals and 47 occurrences.

## Verification (head `252a378f99`)

- Build: `turbo run build` over `./packages/*` and `./packages/*/*`, 71/71, under the verify lock. `driver-sql` was rebuilt directly by the ablation's restore leg, and `driver-turso` directly after the pin mutations (their restore rewrote `remote-transport.ts`). The new sentences are in `dist/index.js` of both packages; the only citations left in either `dist/` are docblocks.
- `@objectstack/driver-turso` tests (`vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, reading the rebuilt `driver-sql` `dist/`): 80 files passed; 2,195 tests passed, 33 skipped.
- `@objectstack/driver-sql` tests: 201 files passed and 11 skipped (the live PG / MySQL cells; no server here); 3,254 tests passed, 188 skipped.
- `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm` (extends `SqlDriver`): 36 files, 675 tests passed.
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/driver-turso` and `@objectstack/driver-sql` `typecheck` exit 0; `tsc --listFiles` for `driver-turso` reads 80 test files, both re-pinned ones among them.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths; 8 paths against merge base `72f8c3820`) names 71 commands, and all 71 exit 0. `check:type-check-debt` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `driver-turso`'s type entry older than its sources, after the mutation restore); after the direct `driver-turso` rebuild it exits 0, and `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` were re-run there too. `--ran` with exit codes recorded: "71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check:doc-authoring`: "sibling-package prose ids hold the baseline — 615 pinned site(s) across 200 file(s) ... no growth, no burn-down unrecorded".
- Narrowed lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 6 touched `.ts` files reports 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The resolved `parserOptions` are `ecmaVersion: latest` and `sourceType: module` only, with no `project` or `projectService`, so no type-aware rule can move an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- NOT MEASURED locally (CI's): the live PG / MySQL cells of the `driver-sql` suite (the required `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` job runs them), the Test Core shards, Dogfood, and the workspace type-check lanes. `origin/main` moved 4 commits after the branch point; none touches these files or the ledger, and CI tests the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

- **Cited cards read.** The 15 objectstack issues cited read closed as completed, and PR 5368 is merged; no cited decision has been reversed. The 10 cloud-repository ids (1003, 1004, 1005, 1051, 1058, 1066, 1073, 1075, 1076, 1116) are not readable from this session (the REST read answers 403, repository not enabled). The same numbers in this repository are unrelated cards, so they were never resolvable here. Those sentences were rewritten from their own words and the file's docblocks, checked against today's code.
- **Noted, not filed (carrier: #20595).** `remote-transport.ts`'s comments and docblocks still cite those bare cloud ids, which in this repository resolve to unrelated cards. Comments are outside this ruling and belong to #20595.
- **Noted, not filed (carrier: stage 5 of this card).** `driver-memory`'s non-boolean `$null` refusal (`filter-refusal.ts`) still ends with its citation; `driver-memory` is in stage 5.
- **Noted, not filed (carrier: none).** `rest`'s `rest-4xx-message-truncation.test.ts` builds its own copy of `driver-sql`'s `$null` sentence, citation included, as a truncation fixture. It is a test file outside the ledger, and nothing compares it with the driver's text.
- **Noted, not filed (carrier: none).** The test titles in `driver-turso`'s `*.test.ts` files still carry cloud ids (for example the refusal-envelope table in `remote-transport-null-comparand-refusal.test.ts`). They are test files, outside the ledger and outside the ruling's shipped-`src/` scope.
- **Noted, not filed (carrier: none).** The new `$null` sentence says "every driver", not "every evaluator": `@objectstack/formula`'s `matchesFilter` reads a non-`true` `$null` as IS NOT NULL. Nothing here measured a public door that hands it a non-boolean, so this is a reading only.
